correctness.rationale: The binomial identity J_d^n=sum_k binom(n,k)N^k and affine summation yield the exact triangular fixed equations. The last coordinate gives necessary/sufficient n a_d=0 in T. The remaining upper-triangular integral torus endomorphism has diagonal entries n, is surjective, and has kernel index n^(d-1), with x1 free; hence exactly n^(d-1) disjoint fixed circles whenever q|n. Every circle shares one least period because returns do not depend on x1, so Möbius inversion gives C_{qℓ}=q^(d−1)J_{d−1}(ℓ). Euler prime products yield inf 0 for d=2 and 1/zeta(d−1) for d>=3. Log component-zeta is q^(d−2)Li_{2−d}(z^q), a rational exponent with poles at qth roots, giving essential singularities after exponentiation. Independently verified d=2 congruence representatives and Jordan totient counts in exact rational arithmetic; other dimensions follow the proof, not finite enumeration.
